title: Solo building is nice and all but, someone who is dedicated to animations, or assets would be a better use of peoples time and make jobs out of it
author: Classroom-Obvious

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: I’m a little lost on what you mean? That it would be nice if we had someone to build our assets and animations? I build most of my own assets on mine but Claude is better at it than me these days

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body:
Can't believe I have to say this since it's counter to my usual stance:

Can you please run what you're trying to say through AI and post its response? I can't figure out what you're getting at.

replies.author: Mindestiny
replies.body:
They're saying that trying to do everything as a solo dev is not as efficient as having a team of people who are dedicated to their own tasks - the "scenario writer that's using AI" and "the artist that's using AI" and "the QA engineer that's using AI."

Which like... no shit?  AI or no, having specific people working on specific tasks in parallel as a team is much more efficient than being a one man show.

replies.author: Classroom-Obvious
replies.body: thank you for understanding my tism

comments.author: IriFlina
comments.body: Well, i'm sure a lot of solo devs would love to have someone dedicated to making animation or assets, but they don't have animation/asset money to pay those people to do those things.

replies.author: Mindestiny
replies.body: There's also the issue of creative freedom.  Every new person on "the team" now has a stake in the product and wants equal input.  That's helpful in a structured team like a studio where someone's job is to have the final say.  Get's really muddy and really drama-fueled when it's just three randos working together.

comments.author: mxblacksmith
comments.body: They exist and are known as artists and technical artists.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: Give me the money and I immediately hire someone for my animations. No second thought. But I can't even spare 500€ a month, how am I going to pay someone doing full time animations...

replies.author: Classroom-Obvious
replies.body: it would be infinitely cheaper to outsource animation creators in here and etc

replies.author: Livid_Shallot5701
replies.body: so lets say i need 400 hours of animation work in the next 2 months. what should i do according to you?

replies.author: Classroom-Obvious
replies.body: according to me give me 5% of your game sales and I will use my max pro plan to build whatever animation you want

replies.author: Livid_Shallot5701
replies.body: ok but thats already what i am doing
